headline: AQI: Dhaka ranks 5th most polluted city in the world
summary: The capital city's air quality index continues to be a major health concern as it climbs the global pollution rankings.
details: Dhaka has been ranked as the 5th most polluted city globally based on the latest Air Quality Index (AQI) data.
The city's air quality frequently reaches hazardous levels, posing significant health risks to millions of residents.
Major contributors to pollution in the capital include construction dust, brick kilns, and vehicle emissions.
Health experts warn that prolonged exposure to this level of pollution can lead to severe respiratory issues and other long-term health complications.

headline_marked: [[India and Pakistan to clash]] in 2027 Cricket World Cup pool phase
headline: India and Pakistan to clash in 2027 Cricket World Cup pool phase
summary: The fierce rivals have been drawn in the same group for the 2027 Cricket World Cup, set to be co-hosted by South Africa, Namibia, and Zimbabwe.
details: Cricket's biggest rivalry will be reignited on the world stage as India and Pakistan have been placed in the same group for the 2027 ICC Cricket World Cup. The highly anticipated match is scheduled to take place at The Wanderers in Johannesburg on October 10, 2027.

The tournament, co-hosted by South Africa, Namibia, and Zimbabwe, will see India also face Australia in their pool, a repeat of the 2023 final. This opening match of the second stage is set for Cape Town on October 7.

Group A also includes Afghanistan, co-host Zimbabwe, and one yet-to-be-determined qualifier. The top three teams from each group will advance to the Super 7 phase, along with the best fourth-placed team from the two pools.

Group B features co-hosts South Africa, England, New Zealand, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, and another qualifier. South Africa, who are yet to win the World Cup, will be looking to make their mark on home soil.

The 2027 edition introduces a new 14-team format with three distinct phases before the semi-finals. This includes a 'Super Series' involving the lower-ranked qualifiers and a 'Super 7' phase where all teams play each other.

The semi-finals are scheduled for November 17 and 18, with the final to be held in Johannesburg on November 21. Reserved days are in place for both semi-finals and the final in case of unforeseen circumstances.
